chunks.page_content: Samuel Royal Thurston was the first delegate from the Oregon Territory to the United States Congress. Samuel Royal Thurston was an American pioneer. Samuel Royal Thurston was instrumental in the passage of the Donation Land Claim Act.

chunks.page_content: One person served as provisional governor of Dakota Territory prior to the period between March 2, 1861, and November 2, 1889. One person served as acting governor of Dakota Territory during the period between March 2, 1861, and November 2, 1889. Ten individuals served as Governors of Dakota Territory.

chunks.chunk_summary: This chunk contains information about the history, formation, and administrative structure of Florida's counties.
chunks.page_content: Escambia County and St. Johns County were divided by the Suwannee River. Florida's counties are subdivisions of the state government of Florida. Gilchrist County was formed from a segment of Alachua County in 1925. Florida became the 27th U.S. state in 1845. The last county in Florida was created in 1925. Gilchrist County is the last county created in Florida. All of the other counties in Florida were apportioned from Escambia County and St. Johns County. St. Johns County was to the east when Florida became a U.S. territory in 1821. There are 67 counties in the state of Florida. All but two of Florida's county seats are incorporated municipalities. Florida had two counties complementing the provincial divisions retained as a Spanish territory when Florida became a U.S. territory in 1821. Escambia County was to the west when Florida became a U.S. territory in 1821. In 1968, counties in Florida gained the power to develop their own charters. Florida became a territory of the U.S. in 1821.

chunks.chunk_summary: This chunk contains information about the historical status, organization, existence dates, international claims, territorial extent, statehood admission, and capital of the Territory of Oregon.
chunks.page_content: When established, the Territory of Oregon encompassed an area that included parts of Montana. The capital of the Territory of Oregon was briefly Corvallis. The region of the Territory of Oregon was divided between the UK and US in 1846. The capital of the Territory of Oregon was first Oregon City. When established, the Territory of Oregon encompassed an area that included parts of Wyoming. When established, the Territory of Oregon encompassed an area that included the current state of Washington. The region of the Territory of Oregon is also known as Oregon Country. When established, the Territory of Oregon encompassed an area that included the current state of Idaho. The capital of the Territory of Oregon returned to Salem after Corvallis. When established, the Territory of Oregon encompassed an area that included the current state of Oregon. The region of the Territory of Oregon was originally claimed by several countries. The Territory of Oregon existed from August 14, 1848, until February 14, 1859. Salem became the state capital upon Oregon's admission to the Union. The southwestern portion of the Territory of Oregon was admitted to the Union as the State of Oregon on February 14, 1859. The Territory of Oregon was an organized incorporated territory of the United States. The capital of the Territory of Oregon was then Salem.

chunks.chunk_summary: This chunk contains information about the history, existence dates, and statehood transition of the Territory of Iowa.
chunks.page_content: The Territory of Iowa was an organized incorporated territory of the United States. The remainder of the Territory of Iowa had no organized territorial government after December 28, 1846. The Territory of Iowa existed from July 4, 1838, until December 28, 1846. The southeastern portion of the Territory of Iowa was admitted to the Union as the State of Iowa on December 28, 1846. The remainder of the Territory of Iowa had no organized territorial government until the Minnesota Territory was organized on March 3, 1849.

chunks.chunk_summary: This chunk contains information about the birth and death dates of historical figures.
chunks.page_content: Samuel Royal Thurston was born on April 15, 1816. Samuel Royal Thurston died on April 9, 1851.

chunks.chunk_summary: This chunk contains information about the historical naming, definition, geographical scope, political status, and timeline of the Northwest Territory following the American Revolutionary War.
chunks.page_content: The post-American Revolutionary War Territory Northwest of the River Ohio is more commonly known as the Northwest Territory. The southeastern portion of the Northwest Territory was admitted to the Union as the state of Ohio on March 1, 1803. The Northwest Territory encompassed most of the pre-war territory of the Ohio Country. The Northwest Territory existed legally from July 13, 1787, until March 1, 1803. The Northwest Territory encompassed parts of old French Canada below the Great Lakes. The remainder of the Northwest Territory was reorganized by additional legislative actions after March 1, 1803. The Northwest Territory spanned most or large parts of six eventual U.S. States. The Northwest Territory encompassed parts of Illinois Country. The Northwest Territory was an organized incorporated territory of the United States.

chunks.chunk_summary: This chunk contains information about the historical timeline and statehood admission of the Dakota Territory.
chunks.context_title: List of Governors of Dakota Territory
chunks.page_content: Dakota Territory existed as an organized incorporated territory of the United States between March 2, 1861, and November 2, 1889. The final extent of the reduced Dakota Territory was split and admitted to the Union as the states of North and South Dakota on November 2, 1889.

chunks.chunk_summary: This chunk contains information about the historical naming, organization, political status, existence timeline, and statehood admission of the Territory of Arkansas.
chunks.page_content: The Territory of Arkansas existed from March 2, 1819 until June 15, 1836. The final extent of the Territory of Arkansas was admitted to the Union as the State of Arkansas on June 15, 1836. The Territory of Arkansas was an organized incorporated territory of the United States. The Territory of Arkansas was initially organized as the Territory of Arkansaw.

chunks.chunk_summary: This chunk contains information about the historical status, existence dates, capital locations, and statehood transitions of the Territory of Wisconsin.
chunks.page_content: The Territory of Wisconsin was an organized incorporated territory of the United States. In 1837, the territorial legislature of the Territory of Wisconsin met in Burlington. Belmont was initially chosen as the capital of the Territory of Wisconsin. The Territory of Wisconsin existed from July 3, 1836, until May 29, 1848. In 1838, the territorial capital of the Territory of Wisconsin was moved to Madison. Burlington became part of the Iowa Territory in 1838. An eastern portion of the Territory of Wisconsin was admitted to the Union as the State of Wisconsin on May 29, 1848.
